lessons.title: 把: handle things!
lessons.learn: 把 GRABS objects! 把书放在桌子上 = Take the book, put it on the table. 把门关上 (close the door!), 把茶喝了 (drink up the tea!). Object JUMPS before the verb — with a result attached!

grammar.title: 把 + object + verb + result
grammar.explain: 把门关上 (close the door), 把作业写完 (finish homework), 把茶喝了 (drink the tea up). Verb needs a RESULT: 上/完/了/给…!

examples.r: bǎ shū fàng zài zhuō zi shang.
examples.en: Put the book on the table.

mistakes: Saying 把书放 — verbs need RESULTS: 放在…上!
Using 把 for new info — 把 handles KNOWN things!

dialogue.r: bǎ shū fàng zài zhuō zi shang!
dialogue.en: Put the book on the table!

dialogue.r: hǎo! bǎ mén guān shang ma?
dialogue.en: OK! Shall I close the door?

lessons.title: 被: passive + 是…的
lessons.learn: Bad things HAPPEN with 被! 我的杯子被打破了 (my cup got broken). 是…的 stresses HOW/WHEN: 我是昨天来的 (it was YESTERDAY I came). Passive pain + emphasis power!

grammar.title: 被 + doer + verb · 是…的
grammar.explain: 杯子被打破了 (cup got broken), 我被雨淋了 (I got rained on). 是…的: 我是坐车来的 (I came BY CAR — stress!).
grammar.pattern: X 被 (doer) verb了 · 是 + detail + 的

examples.r: wǒ de bēi zi bèi dǎ pò le.
wǒ shì zuó tiān lái de.

mistakes: Saying 被 for happy things — 被 loves BAD news!
Forgetting 的: 是…的 needs BOTH!

dialogue.en: It was the CAT that broke it!

lessons.title: Family: 家
lessons.learn: Family! 爸爸 (dad), 妈妈 (mum), 哥哥 (older brother), 姐姐 (older sister), 弟弟/妹妹 (younger). Age-ranked! 的 = 's: 我的妈妈 (my mum), 他的爸爸 (his dad)!

grammar.title: 的 possession + sibling ranks
grammar.explain: 我的书 (my book), 他的妈妈 (his mum). Siblings: 哥哥/弟弟 (older/younger brother), 姐姐/妹妹 (older/younger sister) — age matters!
grammar.pattern: X + 的 + thing · 哥哥/弟弟

examples.r: wǒ bà ba shì lǎo shī.
wǒ jiā yǒu sì kǒu rén.

mistakes: Saying 我的爸爸 always — close family drops 的: 我爸爸!
Calling older brother 弟弟 — older: 哥哥!

lessons.title: Age: 几岁/多大

lessons.title: Opinions: 我觉得 + 比
lessons.learn: Opine! 我觉得… (I feel that…): 我觉得地铁很好! Compare with 比: 北京比上海大 (Beijing is bigger than Shanghai). 更 (even more), 最 (most): 最好 = best!

grammar.title: 我觉得… + A比B + adj
grammar.explain: 我觉得地铁很好 (I think the subway is good). 北京比上海大 (Beijing is bigger than Shanghai). 更大 (even bigger), 最好 (best)!
grammar.pattern: 觉得… · A 比 B + adj · 更/最

examples.r: wǒ jué de dì tiě hěn hǎo.
examples.en: I think the subway is good.

examples.r: Běi jīng bǐ Shàng hǎi dà.

mistakes: Saying 比北京上海大 — order: A比B: 北京比上海大!
Saying 最很好 — 最 replaces 很: 最好!

dialogue.en: I think the subway is good.

lessons.title: Weather: 天气
lessons.learn: Weather! 天气怎么样? (How's the weather?) → 很冷 (It's cold). 下雨 (it rains), 下雪 (it snows). Degree: 太冷了 (too cold!), 冷极了 (extremely cold)!

grammar.title: 下雨/下雪 · 太…了
grammar.explain: 下雨了 (it's raining — rain falls!), 下雪了 (it's snowing). 太冷了 (too cold), 很暖和 (very warm). 明天很暖和 (tomorrow is warm)!
grammar.pattern: 下 + 雨/雪 · 太 adj 了
mistakes: Saying 雨下 — order: 下雨 (fall-rain)!
Saying 冷 for weather-cold-feeling — feeling-cold: 我觉得冷!
